external_entities.name: admin
external_entities.description: The administrator who maintains the database directly.
external_entities.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly
external_entities.notes: The admin connects from wherever they happen to be; no jump host is used.

data_flows.name: access site
data_flows.description: Readers access the public site through the web server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: readers hit the web server over HTTPS
data_flows.notes: Some readers are signed in, but the authentication mechanism is not stated.
data_flows.data_description: Pages, account-related data, comments, and site requests/responses

data_flows.name: fetch assets
data_flows.description: Readers fetch images, stylesheets, and downloads from the CDN.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readers fetch those from the CDN over HTTP.

data_flows.name: publish assets
data_flows.description: The web server pushes newly published assets to the CDN bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When new assets are published the web server pushes them up to the CDN's bucket.
data_flows.notes: Nothing in the source states how this push is authenticated.

data_flows.name: keep content
data_flows.description: The web server keeps pages, accounts, and comments in the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web server runs the CMS and keeps pages, accounts and comments in a MySQL database

data_flows.name: maintain database
data_flows.description: The admin directly maintains the MySQL database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: There is an admin who maintains the database directly
data_flows.notes: The connection is unsecured, uses no TLS, goes straight to the box, and there is no jump host.

trust_boundaries.name: public
trust_boundaries.description: The public network from which readers access the site and the admin connects from an unspecified location.

trust_boundaries.description: The hosted network containing the web server and MySQL database.

trust_boundaries.name: CDN
trust_boundaries.description: The trust zone containing the CDN and its bucket.

assumptions.assumption: The web server is internet-facing because the source describes it as serving the public site.
assumptions.basis: The source says 'Public site: readers hit the web server over HTTPS'.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is controlled separately from the hosted network and therefore forms a tenant trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The source refers to 'the CDN's bucket', describing a separately named CDN-controlled location.

assumptions.assumption: The web server and MySQL database belong to the hosted-network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The source says the web server and database are on 'the same hosted network'.

assumptions.assumption: The MySQL database belongs to the hosted-network trust boundary.
assumptions.basis: The source says the database is 'on the same hosted network' as the web server.
